fields.System.Title: INT-503 — Orphaned reservations
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want reservations with no live order found automatically,
so that stock made invisible by a missed release path is recovered in days rather than
months.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a reservation whose order line is cancelled, shipped, archived, or missing, then
  • it appears on the report with product, location, quantity, age, and claimed order.
  • - Given a balance where the sum of reservation rows does not equal qty_reserved, then
  • the discrepancy is reported.
  • - Given any finding, then an alert reaches a person.
  • - Given a finding, then the report does not release anything automatically — a human
  • decides.
  • - Given the report, then it runs nightly.
  • - Given an orphan, then the report links to the release path most likely responsible, so
  • the code bug can be found rather than only the data corrected.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform, inventory, outbound |
| Tables | reservation, stock_balance, order_line |
| Risks | Reservation leak ([doc 09 §5.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); orphans from no cross-module FKs ([doc 02 §4](../../../docs/02-architecture-overview.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
